title: DTN tests: expiry==0 valid-clock drop case + zero coverage of lichen_router_dtn_expire
description: Review finding from b7z9.8.2.2 (pass 3). Two host-test gaps in lichen/tests/routing_dispatch: (1) no test covers S-flag with expiry==0 at a valid clock (router.c:701 branch: silent drop); test 8 only covers expiry=50<now=100. (2) No test anywhere calls lichen_router_dtn_expire, so the flush behavior (including the expiry==0 interplay filed in 6dh4) is unverified. Related: b7z9.8.2.3 is the ztest-level matrix; this bead is the host-side unit gap.
